Smart (automatic moderate resizing of suitable images)
Maximum (stronger automatic resizing, quality may differ)

The app picks the resize factor for each image by itself after measuring detail loss, and only resizes character atlases whose scale it can fix provably. Everything else is skipped. Test the result in game: this has not been tested.
